chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Senani al-Mokattib (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn Harun al-Soofi said: Ubaydullah ibn Musa al-Hibal al-Tabary narrated to us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Hussein al-Khisahab, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Mohsin, on the authority of Yunus ibn Zabyan, that Ja'far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (peace be upon them) said:

Indeed, people worship the Exalted the Honorable God in three ways: A class worships Him out of desire for His reward; that is the worship of the greedy, which is hope/desire. Others worship Him out of fear of the Fire; that is the worship of the servants, which is fear. But I worship Him out of love for Him, the Exalted the Honorable; that is the worship of the noble ones, which is security.
And they will be secure from terror that Day
Say: If ye do love God, Follow me: God will love you and forgive you your sins
Therefore, whoever loves God, God the Exalted the Honorable loves him. And whoever God the Exalted the Honorable loves is amongst the secure ones.
ai.seo_question: What are the three levels of worship in Shia Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Khisal outlines the Shia theological hierarchy of worship, elevating 'Ishq' (divine love) above 'Raja'' (hope) and 'Khawf' (fear) as the mark of the 'Kiram' (noble ones). Imam al-Sadiq (AS) connects this highest state to the Quranic promise of security on Judgment Day, reflecting the tradition's emphasis on love as the transformative essence of faith rather than merely a transactional mechanism.
